acceptance: GREEN: the named connector/account owner leaves a verified reviewer-capacity manifest with dispatch response, reviewer identity, queue transition, bounded timeout, review receipt, and evidence paths; the machine command validates that manifest. No local fake reviewer result is accepted.
acceptance_cmd: test -f ops/tests/fixtures/ticket_factory_contracts/IMP-20260810-528736.json && jq -e '.ticket_id == "IMP-20260810-528736" and .status == "verified" and (.reviewer_id | type == "string" and length > 0) and (.steps | type == "array" and length >= 1) and all(.steps[]; ((.dispatch_status | type) == "string") and ((.queue_transition | type) == "string") and ((.evidence_path | type) == "string" and length > 0))' ops/tests/fixtures/ticket_factory_contracts/IMP-20260810-528736.json
brief: reviewer dispatch 遇到 thread limit 後沒有可見的 bounded retry 或排隊結果，交付波次可能缺少 review receipt。
contract_evidence: Contract rechecked against f36e9576ab70b7fafdc2b0baa2fc1934b3f83dd9 on 2026-08-18. The reviewer-capacity procedure is now paired with a tracked pending evidence manifest and a rerunnable jq validator. The fixture is explicitly pending/red; no connector action or evidence is claimed.
detail: While reviewing commit 02b5a07bb0a7acc5e349194ee3bb1314f9d4b6c0, multi_agent_v1__spawn_agent returned agent thread limit reached; sending the follow-up to the existing reviewer produced a submission but no response within the bounded wait. Fresh machine gates and tests passed, but review_audit still reports missing receipts.
plan: 把 spawn capacity exhausted、follow-up accepted、follow-up timed out、reviewer terminal 與 missing receipt 分成可觀測狀態；dispatcher 必須 bounded retry 或明確 queue，不可把 submission 成功當成 reviewer 完成。review_audit 只在 terminal receipt 可驗時放行；connector capacity 不可用時 fail closed。先修 review_discipline 與 code-reviewer contract 的狀態定義，再由可用 connector 補 regression，保留現有 machine gate 結果不變。
source: Reviewer dispatch was rejected by the agent thread limit and the existing reviewer follow-up timed out during final Delivery Team closure
